appName.description: Extension display name shown in the Chrome toolbar and extensions list.

appDesc.message: Back up ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini chats to local Markdown, PDF, JSON, or HTML files. Nothing leaves your browser.
appDesc.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and extensions list.

downloadMdLabel.description: Label for the Markdown export button.

downloadPdfLabel.description: Label for the PDF export button.

downloadJsonLabel.description: Label for the JSON export button.

downloadHtmlLabel.description: Label for the HTML export button.

downloadMdAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for the Markdown export button.

downloadPdfAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for the PDF export button.

downloadJsonAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for the JSON export button.

downloadHtmlAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for the HTML export button.

exportNoAdapterMessage.message: This page is not a supported conversation, so there is nothing to export.
exportNoAdapterMessage.description: Shown when the current page is not a recognized conversation.

exportFailedMessage.message: Could not export this conversation. Please try again.
exportFailedMessage.description: Generic fallback for an unexpected export failure.

exportEmptyMessage.message: This conversation has no messages, so there is nothing to export.
exportEmptyMessage.description: Shown when extraction returns a conversation with no messages.

pdfFontLoadFailedMessage.message: Could not load the PDF fonts from the extension. Reload the page and try again.
pdfFontLoadFailedMessage.description: Shown when the PDF exporter cannot read its font faces out of the extension package.

pdfMissingGlyphsMessage.message: The PDF was saved, but the built-in font has no glyph for $count$ distinct characters in it, and they appear as empty boxes: $samples$. Export as Markdown or HTML to keep them.
pdfMissingGlyphsMessage.description: Shown after a PDF export that succeeded but contains characters the embedded font cannot draw, so they appear as empty boxes. $count$ is how many DISTINCT characters were affected, not how many times they occur — say so, or a conversation with 800 kana drawn from 20 distinct ones reads as barely affected. Worded to avoid a count-governed plural noun — chrome.i18n has no plural forms and $count$ can be 1.

downloadBulkLabel.description: Label for the toolbar button that opens the bulk-export panel.

downloadBulkAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for the bulk-export toolbar button.

downloadProjectBulkLabel.description: Label for the trigger that bulk-downloads a project's conversations.

downloadProjectBulkAriaLabel.message: Download all conversations in this project
downloadProjectBulkAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for the project bulk-download trigger.

downloadRecentsBulkAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for the bulk-download trigger on the full history page.

bulkPanelTitle.description: Title of the bulk-export selection panel.

bulkPanelFormatLabel.description: Label for the format picker in the bulk-export panel.

bulkPanelSelectAll.description: Select-all control in the bulk-export panel.

bulkPanelCancel.description: Cancel button in the bulk-export panel.

bulkPanelClose.description: Close button in the bulk-export panel.

bulkPanelLoadMore.description: Button in the bulk-export panel that loads conversations not yet rendered in the virtualized source list.

bulkPanelLoadMoreBusy.description: Busy label on the Load more button while it scrolls the source list.

bulkPanelLoadMoreDone.description: Disabled label on the Load more button once every conversation has been loaded.

bulkLoadMoreProgressMessage.description: Progress line while Load more walks the virtualized list. Worded to avoid a count-governed plural noun — chrome.i18n has no plural forms and $count$ can be 1.

bulkLoadMoreIncompleteMessage.message: Conversations loaded: $count$. The list may be incomplete — click Load more again.
bulkLoadMoreIncompleteMessage.description: Shown when Load more stopped while the page-size parity check still expected another page, so the list may be short. Worded to avoid a count-governed plural noun — chrome.i18n has no plural forms and $count$ can be 1.

bulkEmptyMessage.message: No conversations were found to export.
bulkEmptyMessage.description: Shown when no conversations are available to export (empty history sidebar or empty project).

bulkListErrorMessage.message: Could not read the conversation list: $error$
bulkListErrorMessage.description: Shown when a provider's conversation-list extraction fails before the bulk panel can render its selection list.

bulkUnsupportedMessage.message: Bulk export is not available on this page.
bulkUnsupportedMessage.description: Shown when the current page's adapter does not support bulk export.

bulkExportButtonLabel.description: Export-button label with the current selected count.

bulkProgressMessage.description: In-progress line shown while a batch runs.

bulkSummarySaved.description: Final summary line after a batch: how many succeeded.

bulkSummaryFailed.description: Appended to the summary line when some exports failed.

coachMarkTitle.message: Find Prompt Vault in your toolbar
coachMarkTitle.description: Heading of the first-run coach mark that points at the browser toolbar.

coachMarkBody.message: Click the puzzle-piece (Extensions) button in your browser toolbar, then pin Prompt Vault to keep it one click away.
coachMarkBody.description: Body copy of the first-run coach mark, describing how to pin the extension.

coachMarkCloseLabel.description: Label of the button that dismisses the first-run coach mark.

coachMarkAriaLabel.description: Accessible name of the first-run coach mark dialog.

optionsTitle.description: Browser-tab title of the options page.

optionsHeading.description: Visible heading of the options page.

optionsFormatsLabel.description: Label above the format checklist on the options page.

optionsBulkLabel.description: Label for the bulk-icon toggle on the options page.

optionsSavedNote.description: Transient confirmation shown after a setting change is saved.

optionsSaveFailedNote.message: Could not save. Please try again.
optionsSaveFailedNote.description: Shown when persisting a setting change to storage fails.

optionsMinFormatNote.message: At least one export format must stay enabled.
optionsMinFormatNote.description: Shown when the user tries to uncheck the last remaining format.

errTurnsUnreadable.message: Some conversation turns could not be read (empty or malformed). The conversation may still be loading — wait for it to finish, then try again.
errTurnsUnreadable.description: Extraction error (any provider): some conversation turns were empty or malformed, likely because the page is still loading.

errScrollToStartTimedOut.message: Timed out scrolling back to the start of the conversation. It may be unusually long; try again, or report if this persists.
errScrollToStartTimedOut.description: Extraction error (Claude, Gemini): scrolling back to the first message to load older turns took too long.

errChatgptCodeBlockIncomplete.message: A long code block could not be read in full. Scroll it into view and try again, or report this if it persists.
errChatgptCodeBlockIncomplete.description: Extraction error (ChatGPT): a long, virtualized code block could not be read completely.

errChatgptSidebarLinkMissing.message: Could not open a selected conversation: its link was not found in the sidebar (the history list may need scrolling into view). It was skipped.
errChatgptSidebarLinkMissing.description: Bulk export error (ChatGPT): a selected conversation's sidebar link could not be found, so it was skipped.

errChatgptOpenTimedOut.message: Timed out opening a selected conversation. It may be loading slowly; it was skipped.
errChatgptOpenTimedOut.description: Bulk export error (ChatGPT): opening a selected conversation took too long, so it was skipped.

errChatgptProjectLinkMissing.message: Could not open a selected project conversation: its link was not found on the page (the project list may need scrolling into view). It was skipped.
errChatgptProjectLinkMissing.description: Bulk export error (ChatGPT): a selected project conversation's link could not be found on the project page, so it was skipped.

errChatgptProjectOpenTimedOut.message: Timed out opening a selected project conversation. It may be loading slowly; it was skipped.
errChatgptProjectOpenTimedOut.description: Bulk export error (ChatGPT): opening a selected project conversation took too long, so it was skipped.

errChatgptProjectBackLinkMissing.message: Could not return to the project home: its back link was not found.
errChatgptProjectBackLinkMissing.description: Bulk export error (ChatGPT): after a project batch, the link back to the project home page could not be found.

errChatgptProjectHomeTimedOut.message: Timed out returning to the project home page.
errChatgptProjectHomeTimedOut.description: Bulk export error (ChatGPT): returning to the project home page after a batch took too long.

errChatgptNoMessages.message: No messages found on the page. The conversation may not have loaded, or ChatGPT’s markup changed — extraction selectors need updating.
errChatgptNoMessages.description: Extraction error (ChatGPT): no messages were found on the conversation page.

errChatgptLoadOlderTimedOut.message: Timed out loading the full conversation while scrolling. The conversation may be unusually long; try again, or report if this persists.
errChatgptLoadOlderTimedOut.description: Extraction error (ChatGPT): scrolling to load older messages of the conversation took too long.

errChatgptTurnIdMissing.message: A conversation turn is missing its identifier and could not be exported reliably. ChatGPT’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errChatgptTurnIdMissing.description: Extraction error (ChatGPT): a conversation turn has no identifier, so the export could not be made reliable.

errChatgptSidebarScrollTimedOut.message: Timed out loading the conversation list while scrolling. The sidebar may be unusually long; try again, or report if this persists.
errChatgptSidebarScrollTimedOut.description: Bulk export error (ChatGPT): scrolling the sidebar to load the full conversation list took too long.

errChatgptProjectListScrollTimedOut.message: Timed out loading the project conversation list while scrolling. The list may be unusually long; try again, or report if this persists.
errChatgptProjectListScrollTimedOut.description: Bulk export error (ChatGPT): scrolling the project page to load the full project conversation list took too long.

errGeminiSidebarMissing.message: Could not find Gemini’s conversation sidebar. Gemini’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errGeminiSidebarMissing.description: Bulk export error (Gemini): the conversation sidebar could not be found on the page.

errGeminiSidebarCollapsed.message: Gemini’s conversation sidebar is collapsed, so its conversation links cannot be read. Open the sidebar (the menu button at the top left) and try again.
errGeminiSidebarCollapsed.description: Bulk export error (Gemini): the sidebar is collapsed, so the conversation list cannot be read; tells the user how to open it.

errGeminiSidebarLinksUnreadable.message: Could not read any Gemini sidebar conversation link: their URLs are not the expected /app/<id> shape. Gemini’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errGeminiSidebarLinksUnreadable.description: Bulk export error (Gemini): sidebar links exist but none has the expected /app/<id> URL shape. Keep "/app/<id>" verbatim.

errGeminiOpenUrlMalformed.message: Could not open a selected Gemini conversation: its URL is malformed. It was skipped.
errGeminiOpenUrlMalformed.description: Bulk export error (Gemini): a selected conversation has a malformed URL, so it was skipped.

errGeminiOpenLinkMissing.message: Could not open a selected Gemini conversation: its sidebar link was not found, even after scrolling the conversation list. It was skipped.
errGeminiOpenLinkMissing.description: Bulk export error (Gemini): a selected conversation's sidebar link was not found even after scrolling, so it was skipped.

errGeminiOpenTimedOut.message: Timed out opening a selected Gemini conversation. It may be loading slowly; it was skipped.
errGeminiOpenTimedOut.description: Bulk export error (Gemini): opening a selected conversation took too long, so it was skipped.

errGeminiNoMessages.message: No messages found on the page. The conversation may not have loaded, or Gemini’s markup changed — extraction selectors need updating.
errGeminiNoMessages.description: Extraction error (Gemini): no messages were found on the conversation page.

errGeminiMessageListMissing.message: Could not find Gemini’s message list to scroll, so older messages in this conversation may not have loaded. Gemini’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errGeminiMessageListMissing.description: Extraction error (Gemini): the scrollable message list was not found, so older messages may be missing.

errGeminiMessageListUnscrollable.message: Gemini’s message list cannot be scrolled right now, so older messages in this conversation may not have loaded. Bring the conversation into view and try again.
errGeminiMessageListUnscrollable.description: Extraction error (Gemini): the message list exists but cannot be scrolled right now, so older messages may be missing.

errGeminiExchangesDropped.message: Only $loaded$ of $expected$ loaded exchanges are still on the page — Gemini removed some while they were being read. Scroll through the whole conversation and try again.
errGeminiExchangesDropped.description: Extraction error (Gemini): Gemini unloaded some already-loaded exchanges while they were being read. $loaded$ is how many are still on the page, $expected$ how many had loaded.

errGeminiStillGenerating.message: Gemini is still generating a response. Wait for it to finish, then export again.
errGeminiStillGenerating.description: Extraction error (Gemini): a response is still being generated.

errGeminiResponseUnreadable.message: This conversation contains a response this extension could not read — it may be a kind Gemini renders outside its normal text area, or Gemini’s markup may have changed. Please report this.
errGeminiResponseUnreadable.description: Extraction error (Gemini): a response could not be read, possibly a kind rendered outside the normal text area.

errClaudeArtifactAndAttachment.message: A Claude message carries both an artifact card and a file attachment, which its markup has never done. Its author could not be determined — please report this.
errClaudeArtifactAndAttachment.description: Extraction error (Claude): a message has both an artifact card and a file attachment, so its author (user or Claude) cannot be told apart.

errClaudeSidebarMissing.message: Could not find Claude’s conversation sidebar. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeSidebarMissing.description: Bulk export error (Claude): the conversation sidebar could not be found on the page.

errClaudeProjectListMissing.message: Could not find the Claude project conversation list on a project page. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeProjectListMissing.description: Bulk export error (Claude): the project conversation list was not found on a project page.

errClaudeProjectRowMalformed.message: Could not read the Claude project conversation list: a table row did not contain exactly one conversation link. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeProjectRowMalformed.description: Bulk export error (Claude): a row of the project conversation table did not hold exactly one conversation link.

errClaudeSidebarLinksUnreadable.message: Could not read any Claude sidebar conversation link: their URLs or titles are missing. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeSidebarLinksUnreadable.description: Bulk export error (Claude): sidebar conversation links exist but none has both a URL and a title.

errClaudeProjectLinksUnreadable.message: Could not read any Claude project conversation link: their URLs or titles are missing. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeProjectLinksUnreadable.description: Bulk export error (Claude): project conversation links exist but none has both a URL and a title.

errClaudeRecentsLinksUnreadable.message: Could not read any Claude recents conversation link: their URLs or titles are missing. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeRecentsLinksUnreadable.description: Bulk export error (Claude): conversation links on the recents page exist but none has both a URL and a title.

errClaudeOpenUrlMalformed.message: Could not open a selected Claude conversation: its URL is malformed. It was skipped.
errClaudeOpenUrlMalformed.description: Bulk export error (Claude): a selected conversation has a malformed URL, so it was skipped.

errClaudeOpenLinkMissing.message: Could not open a selected Claude conversation: its sidebar link was not found, even after scrolling the recent-chat list. It was skipped.
errClaudeOpenLinkMissing.description: Bulk export error (Claude): a selected conversation's sidebar link was not found even after scrolling the recent-chat list, so it was skipped.

errClaudeOpenTimedOut.message: Timed out opening a selected Claude conversation. It may be loading slowly; it was skipped.
errClaudeOpenTimedOut.description: Bulk export error (Claude): opening a selected conversation took too long, so it was skipped.

errClaudeProjectOpenUrlMalformed.message: Could not open a selected Claude project conversation: its URL is malformed. It was skipped.
errClaudeProjectOpenUrlMalformed.description: Bulk export error (Claude): a selected project conversation has a malformed URL, so it was skipped.

errClaudeProjectOpenLinkMissing.message: Could not open a selected Claude project conversation: its table link was not found. The project list may need to render first. It was skipped.
errClaudeProjectOpenLinkMissing.description: Bulk export error (Claude): a selected project conversation's link was not found in the project table, so it was skipped.

errClaudeProjectOpenTimedOut.message: Timed out opening a selected Claude project conversation. It may be loading slowly; it was skipped.
errClaudeProjectOpenTimedOut.description: Bulk export error (Claude): opening a selected project conversation took too long, so it was skipped.

errClaudeProjectHomeUrlMissing.message: Could not return to the Claude project home: no measured project-home URL is available. It was skipped.
errClaudeProjectHomeUrlMissing.description: Bulk export error (Claude): the project home URL recorded at the start of the batch is unavailable, so returning there was skipped.

errClaudeProjectHomeHistoryUnavailable.message: Could not return to the Claude project home: browser history is unavailable. It was skipped.
errClaudeProjectHomeHistoryUnavailable.description: Bulk export error (Claude): browser history is unavailable, so returning to the project home was skipped.

errClaudeProjectHomeTimedOut.message: Timed out returning to the Claude project home. It may be loading slowly; it was skipped.
errClaudeProjectHomeTimedOut.description: Bulk export error (Claude): returning to the project home took too long, so it was skipped.

errClaudeProjectHomeMismatch.message: Returned to a different Claude project home than the bulk run started from.
errClaudeProjectHomeMismatch.description: Bulk export error (Claude): after the batch, the page landed on a different project home than the one the batch started from.

errClaudeRecentsListMissing.message: Could not find the Claude conversation list on the recents page. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeRecentsListMissing.description: Bulk export error (Claude): the conversation list was not found on the recents (/recents) page.

errClaudeRecentsRowMalformed.message: Could not read the Claude recents conversation list: a table row did not contain exactly one conversation link. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeRecentsRowMalformed.description: Bulk export error (Claude): a row of the recents conversation table did not hold exactly one conversation link.

errClaudeRecentsLinksIncomplete.message: Could not read every Claude conversation on the recents page: some rows’ links or titles are missing. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeRecentsLinksIncomplete.description: Bulk export error (Claude): some rows on the recents page lack a link or title, so the list would be incomplete.

errClaudeRecentsLinkMissing.message: Could not open a selected Claude conversation: its link was not found on the recents page. The list may need to render first. It was skipped.
errClaudeRecentsLinkMissing.description: Bulk export error (Claude): a selected conversation's link was not found on the recents page, so it was skipped.

errClaudeRecentsHistoryUnavailable.message: Could not return to the Claude recents page: browser history is unavailable. It was skipped.
errClaudeRecentsHistoryUnavailable.description: Bulk export error (Claude): browser history is unavailable, so returning to the recents page was skipped.

errClaudeRecentsReturnTimedOut.message: Timed out returning to the Claude recents page. It may be loading slowly; it was skipped.
errClaudeRecentsReturnTimedOut.description: Bulk export error (Claude): returning to the recents page took too long, so it was skipped.

errClaudeNotRecentsPage.message: Asked to return to a Claude page that is not the recents list.
errClaudeNotRecentsPage.description: Bulk export error (Claude): the batch was asked to return to a page that is not the recents list.

errClaudeNoMessages.message: No messages found on the page. The conversation may not have loaded, or Claude’s markup changed — extraction selectors need updating.
errClaudeNoMessages.description: Extraction error (Claude): no messages were found on the conversation page.

errClaudeStreamingSettleTimedOut.message: Timed out waiting for Claude’s streaming state to settle while loading the full conversation. The conversation may still be generating or its markup may have changed — try again, or report if this persists.
errClaudeStreamingSettleTimedOut.description: Extraction error (Claude): while loading the full conversation, Claude never finished streaming within the time limit.

errClaudeCompletionMarkerMissing.message: Claude’s message-completion marker was not found anywhere in the conversation, so this extension cannot tell a finished response from one still being written. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeCompletionMarkerMissing.description: Extraction error (Claude): the marker Claude puts on finished responses is absent from the whole conversation, so finished and in-progress responses cannot be told apart.

errClaudeFirstTurnNeverLoaded.message: The conversation’s first turn never loaded, even after scrolling to the top. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeFirstTurnNeverLoaded.description: Extraction error (Claude): the first turn of the conversation never loaded, even after scrolling to the top. Singular form of errClaudeFirstTurnsNeverLoaded.

errClaudeFirstTurnsNeverLoaded.message: The conversation’s first $count$ turns never loaded, even after scrolling to the top. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeFirstTurnsNeverLoaded.description: Extraction error (Claude): the first $count$ turns (always 2 or more) never loaded, even after scrolling to the top.

errClaudeTurnGap.message: The conversation is missing turns between positions $from$ and $to$. Scroll through the whole conversation and try again.
errClaudeTurnGap.description: Extraction error (Claude): turns between two read positions are missing. $from$ and $to$ are zero-based turn positions.

errClaudeLastTurnNeverLoaded.message: The conversation’s last turn never loaded — Claude reports $declared$ messages but only $read$ could be read. Scroll to the end of the conversation and try again.
errClaudeLastTurnNeverLoaded.description: Extraction error (Claude): the last turn never loaded. $declared$ is how many messages Claude says the conversation has, $read$ how many were read. Singular form of errClaudeLastTurnsNeverLoaded.

errClaudeLastTurnsNeverLoaded.message: The conversation’s last $count$ turns never loaded — Claude reports $declared$ messages but only $read$ could be read. Scroll to the end of the conversation and try again.
errClaudeLastTurnsNeverLoaded.description: Extraction error (Claude): the last $count$ turns (always 2 or more) never loaded. $declared$ is how many messages Claude says the conversation has, $read$ how many were read.

errClaudeTurnIndexMissing.message: A conversation turn is missing its position marker and could not be exported reliably. Claude’s markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeTurnIndexMissing.description: Extraction error (Claude): a conversation turn has no position marker, so the export could not be made reliable.

errClaudeUnreadableRow.message: The conversation contains a message at position $positions$ that this extension could not read — Claude’s markup may have changed, or the message may be a type it does not support yet. Please report this.
errClaudeUnreadableRow.description: Extraction error (Claude): a rendered message could not be read. $positions$ is its zero-based position. Singular form of errClaudeUnreadableRows.

errClaudeUnreadableRows.message: The conversation contains messages at position $positions$ that this extension could not read — Claude’s markup may have changed, or the message may be a type it does not support yet. Please report this.
errClaudeUnreadableRows.description: Extraction error (Claude): several rendered messages could not be read. $positions$ is a comma-separated list of zero-based positions.

errClaudeArtifactRootUnrecognized.message: Claude rendered an artifact card with an unrecognized root. Its metadata could not be read — please report this.
errClaudeArtifactRootUnrecognized.description: Extraction error (Claude): an artifact card has an unrecognized root element, so its title and kind could not be read.

errClaudeArtifactOrphan.message: Claude rendered an artifact card without its corresponding assistant message. The markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeArtifactOrphan.description: Extraction error (Claude): an artifact card was found outside any Claude response.

errClaudeArtifactMetadataUnreadable.message: Claude rendered an artifact card whose title or kind could not be read. The markup may have changed — please report this.
errClaudeArtifactMetadataUnreadable.description: Extraction error (Claude): an artifact card's title or kind could not be read.
